_meta.contract: plan.md 7.1 admits a requirement if it is falsifiable, survives the gold plans, and is in scope. Magnitudes are not load-bearing in absolute terms (only in ratio), but ARE load-bearing for asset cardinality and for the blind human read.
_meta.size_scheme: THREE categories, matching Eval_CASTOR human_gt.csv's size_estimate column (small <10m / medium 10-50m / large >50m). The former 'very_large' tier was merged into 'large': human_gt's 'large (>50m)' is open-ended and does not distinguish a 60 m coaster from a 350 m VLCC, so a fourth band would have been an inference the labels do not support. The merged band spans the two old ones, which is why 'large' is wide. DRAFT -- needs M4's review.
_meta.enabling_kit: A non-contributing asset type every ledger for this state carries, on time, in every arm: divers to rig a submerged or inverted hull, a dewatering pump for a fire-damaged one. A precondition on ledger construction, not a check - it contributes to no scalar, so ratio_fleet and ratio_deadline are untouched. docs/corpus_realism.md sec. 2.
